```{R}
# ==============================================================================
# Project: Dependency Ratio Mapping (National & County with Labels)
# Author: PBAG2
# Date: 2025-12-03
# Description: 
#   1. Generates a National Choropleth Map.
#   2. Generates Individual County Maps with Township Labels.
# ==============================================================================

rm(list = ls()) # Clear environment

# 1. Setup & Libraries
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
packages <- c("readr", "dplyr", "stringr", "ggplot2", "sf", "viridis", "here", "ggrepel")
for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# 設定繪圖主題
my_theme_map <- theme_void(base_family = "Microsoft JhengHei") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

# 建立輸出資料夾
dir.create(here("output", "maps_labeled"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Project Root:", here(), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load Data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[1/4] Loading Data...\n")

# 2.1 Load Aging Data
df_aging_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "population_index", "aging_index_202412.csv"), skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(df_aging_raw) <- c("CID", "COUNTY", "TID", "TOWN", "M_F", "PH", "PDEN", 
                            "DEP_RAT", "YOUNG_RAT", "OLD_RAT", "AGING_IDX", "TIME")

aging_data <- df_aging_raw %>%
  rename(Region = COUNTY, District = TOWN) %>%
  mutate(
    Dependency_Ratio = as.numeric(DEP_RAT),
    Region = str_trim(Region),
    District = str_trim(District)
  ) %>%
  # 統一將 "台" 換成 "臺"
  mutate(Region = str_replace_all(Region, "台", "臺")) %>%
  select(Region, District, Dependency_Ratio)

# 2.2 Load Shapefile
shp_path <- here("data", "map", "TOWN_MOI_1140318.shp")
if (!file.exists(shp_path)) stop("錯誤：找不到地圖檔 (TOWN_MOI_1140318.shp)！")

tw_town_sf <- st_read(shp_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  rename(Region = COUNTYNAME, District = TOWNNAME) %>%
  mutate(Region = str_replace_all(Region, "台", "臺"))

# 2.3 Merge Data
map_data_all <- tw_town_sf %>%
  left_join(aging_data, by = c("Region", "District"))

cat("Data Merged. Total Districts:", nrow(map_data_all), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Generate National Map (全台地圖 - 修正範圍版)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[2/4] Generating National Map (Zoomed to Taiwan Area)...\n")

p_national <- ggplot(map_data_all) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Dependency_Ratio), color = NA, size = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma", 
    direction = -1, 
    name = "扶養比 (%)",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "全台各鄉鎮市區扶養比分佈",
    subtitle = "排除外島，聚焦台灣本島",
    caption = "資料來源：內政部統計處"
  ) +
  my_theme_map +
  
  # 關鍵修正：固定經緯度範圍
  # 這個範圍可以包含：台灣本島、澎湖、綠島、蘭嶼、小琉球
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(118.0, 122.4),  # 經度：從澎湖(左) 到 台灣東岸(右)
    ylim = c(21.8, 26.4)     # 緯度：從恆春(下) 到 基隆(上)
  )

# 存檔
ggsave(here("output", "maps_labeled", "Map_National_Total_Fixed.png"), 
       p_national, width = 12, height = 16, bg = "white")

cat("完成！全台地圖已修正範圍並輸出。\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Generate County Maps with Labels (縣市地圖 + 標籤 + 特殊修正)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[3/4] Generating Labeled County Maps (Fixed for Kaohsiung & Yilan)...\n")

county_list <- unique(map_data_all$Region)
county_list <- county_list[!is.na(county_list)]

for (county in county_list) {
  
  cat("  Processing:", county, "...\n")
  
  # 4.1 篩選該縣市資料
  county_map_data <- map_data_all %>% filter(Region == county)
  
  # 4.2 計算中心點 (用於標籤定位)
  county_centroids <- suppressWarnings(st_centroid(county_map_data))
  coords <- st_coordinates(county_centroids)
  county_map_data <- cbind(county_map_data, coords)
  
  # 4.3 繪圖 (標籤設定)
  p <- ggplot(county_map_data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = Dependency_Ratio), color = "white", size = 0.2) +
    
    # 標籤設定 (避免重疊並調整排斥力)
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(x = X, y = Y, label = District),
      size = 3,
      family = "Microsoft JhengHei",
      color = "black",
      bg.color = "white",
      bg.r = 0.15,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      # 針對 高雄市 與 宜蘭縣 增加排斥力，避免標籤擠在一起
      force = ifelse(county %in% c("高雄市", "宜蘭縣"), 1, 10) 
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "magma", 
      direction = -1, 
      name = "扶養比 (%)",
      na.value = "grey90"
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste(county, "- 扶養比分佈"),
      subtitle = "顯示各鄉鎮市區名稱"
    ) +
    my_theme_map
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # 針對特定縣市設定 Zoom In (特殊範圍修正)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  
  # Case 1: 高雄市 (排除東沙、南沙，聚焦本島)
  if (county == "高雄市") {
    p <- p + coord_sf(
      xlim = c(120.15, 121.10),
      ylim = c(22.40, 23.50)
    )
  }
  
  # Case 2: 宜蘭縣 (排除釣魚台，聚焦蘭陽平原)
  else if (county == "宜蘭縣") {
    p <- p + coord_sf(
      xlim = c(121.30, 122.05), # 聚焦：蘭陽平原與龜山島
      ylim = c(24.28, 25.02)    # 聚焦：南澳至頭城
    )
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  
  # 4.4 存檔
  filename <- paste0("Map_Labeled_", county, ".png")
  filepath <- here("output", "maps_labeled", filename)
  
  ggsave(filepath, p, width = 10, height = 10, bg = "white")
}

cat("\n[4/4] All Done! Kaohsiung and Yilan maps are now fixed.\n")
```

```{R}
#12230136
# ==============================================================================
# Project: Dependency Ratio Mapping (English Labels with Values)
# Author: PBAG2
# Date: 2025-12-03
# Description: 
#   1. Generates a National Choropleth Map (English).
#   2. Generates County Maps with English Labels & Percentage Values.
# ==============================================================================

rm(list = ls()) # Clear environment

# 1. Setup & Libraries
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
packages <- c("readr", "dplyr", "stringr", "ggplot2", "sf", "viridis", "here", "ggrepel")
for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# Define Theme (English Font preferred, e.g., Arial or Helvetica)
my_theme_map <- theme_void(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey60", hjust = 1)
  )

# Create Output Directory
dir.create(here("output", "maps_eng_labeled"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Project Root:", here(), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load Data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[1/4] Loading Data...\n")

# 2.1 Load Aging Data
df_aging_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "population_index", "aging_index_202412.csv"), skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(df_aging_raw) <- c("CID", "COUNTY", "TID", "TOWN", "M_F", "PH", "PDEN", 
                            "DEP_RAT", "YOUNG_RAT", "OLD_RAT", "AGING_IDX", "TIME")

aging_data <- df_aging_raw %>%
  rename(Region_Chi = COUNTY, District_Chi = TOWN) %>%
  mutate(
    Dependency_Ratio = as.numeric(DEP_RAT),
    Region_Chi = str_trim(Region_Chi),
    District_Chi = str_trim(District_Chi)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Region_Chi = str_replace_all(Region_Chi, "台", "臺")) %>%
  select(Region_Chi, District_Chi, Dependency_Ratio)

# 2.2 Load Shapefile (With English Names)
shp_path <- here("data", "map", "TOWN_MOI_1140318.shp")
if (!file.exists(shp_path)) stop("Error: Shapefile not found (TOWN_MOI_1140318.shp)!")

# Read Shapefile and try to get English names
# Standard MOI shapefiles usually have COUNTYENG and TOWNENG
tw_town_sf <- st_read(shp_path, quiet = TRUE)

# Check if English columns exist, otherwise define mapping manually or warn
if (!("TOWNENG" %in% names(tw_town_sf))) {
  warning("Warning: 'TOWNENG' column not found in shapefile! Labels might remain Chinese.")
  tw_town_sf <- tw_town_sf %>%
    rename(Region_Chi = COUNTYNAME, District_Chi = TOWNNAME) %>%
    mutate(Region_Eng = Region_Chi, District_Eng = District_Chi) # Fallback
} else {
  tw_town_sf <- tw_town_sf %>%
    rename(
      Region_Chi = COUNTYNAME, 
      District_Chi = TOWNNAME,
      Region_Eng = COUNTYENG,
      District_Eng = TOWNENG
    )
}

# Fix "Tai" char in Chinese columns for merging
tw_town_sf <- tw_town_sf %>%
  mutate(Region_Chi = str_replace_all(Region_Chi, "台", "臺"))

# 2.3 Merge Data
# Merge based on CHINESE names (Region_Chi, District_Chi) to ensure accuracy
map_data_all <- tw_town_sf %>%
  left_join(aging_data, by = c("Region_Chi", "District_Chi")) %>%
  # Create the final Label Text: "Name \n Value%"
  mutate(
    Label_Text = paste0(District_Eng, "\n", round(Dependency_Ratio, 1), "%")
  )

cat("Data Merged. Total Districts:", nrow(map_data_all), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Generate National Map (English)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[2/4] Generating National Map...\n")

p_national <- ggplot(map_data_all) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Dependency_Ratio), color = NA, size = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma", 
    direction = -1, 
    name = "Dependency\nRatio (%)",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Dependency Ratio by District in Taiwan",
    subtitle = "Higher Ratio indicates heavier burden on working population",
    caption = "Source: Ministry of the Interior | Visualized by R"
  ) +
  my_theme_map +
  # Fixed Coordinates for Taiwan Main Island
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(118.0, 122.4), 
    ylim = c(21.8, 26.4)
  )

ggsave(here("output", "maps_eng_labeled", "Map_National_Eng.png"), 
       p_national, width = 12, height = 16, bg = "white")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Generate County Maps (English Labels + Values)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[3/4] Generating County Maps with English Labels & Values...\n")

# Use Chinese names for filtering loop, but use English names for filenames/titles
county_list <- unique(map_data_all$Region_Chi)
county_list <- county_list[!is.na(county_list)]

for (county_chi in county_list) {
  
  # Get English Name for this county (take the first one found)
  county_eng <- map_data_all$Region_Eng[map_data_all$Region_Chi == county_chi][1]
  
  # Clean up filename (remove spaces or special chars if any)
  filename_part <- str_replace_all(county_eng, " ", "")
  
  cat("  Processing:", county_eng, "(", county_chi, ")...\n")
  
  # 4.1 Filter Data
  county_map_data <- map_data_all %>% filter(Region_Chi == county_chi)
  
  # 4.2 Calculate Centroids for Labels
  county_centroids <- suppressWarnings(st_centroid(county_map_data))
  coords <- st_coordinates(county_centroids)
  county_map_data <- cbind(county_map_data, coords)
  
  # 4.3 Plotting
  p <- ggplot(county_map_data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = Dependency_Ratio), color = "white", size = 0.2) +
    
    # *** English Labels with Percentage ***
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(x = X, y = Y, label = Label_Text),
      size = 3,                 # Font size
      family = "Arial",         # English font
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black",
      bg.color = "white",       # White outline for readability
      bg.r = 0.15,
      lineheight = 0.8,         # Adjust line spacing for 2-line labels
      min.segment.length = 0,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      # Add repulsion force for dense areas (e.g. Kaohsiung, Taipei)
      force = ifelse(county_eng %in% c("Kaohsiung City", "Taipei City", "New Taipei City"), 2, 5),
      max.overlaps = 30         # Allow more labels to show
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "magma", 
      direction = -1, 
      name = "Dep. Ratio (%)",
      na.value = "grey90"
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste(county_eng, "- Dependency Ratio"),
      subtitle = "Label format: District Name / Percentage (%)",
      caption = "PBAG2 Analysis"
    ) +
    my_theme_map
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Specific Zoom Adjustments
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (county_chi == "高雄市") {
    p <- p + coord_sf(xlim = c(120.15, 121.10), ylim = c(22.40, 23.50))
  } else if (county_chi == "宜蘭縣") {
    p <- p + coord_sf(xlim = c(121.30, 122.05), ylim = c(24.28, 25.02))
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  
  # 4.4 Save
  filepath <- here("output", "maps_eng_labeled", paste0("Map_", filename_part, "_Eng.png"))
  ggsave(filepath, p, width = 10, height = 10, bg = "white")
}

cat("\n[4/4] All Done! Check 'output/maps_eng_labeled' folder.\n")

```

```{r}
#0138
# ==============================================================================
# Project: Dependency Ratio Mapping (Robust English Version)
# Author: PBAG2
# Date: 2025-12-03
# Description: 
#   1. Handles Shapefiles missing English columns.
#   2. Uses manual dictionary for translation.
#   3. Generates English Maps with Values.
# ==============================================================================

rm(list = ls()) # Clear environment

# 1. Setup & Libraries
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
packages <- c("readr", "dplyr", "stringr", "ggplot2", "sf", "viridis", "here", "ggrepel")
for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# Theme
my_theme_map <- theme_void(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey60", hjust = 1)
  )

dir.create(here("output", "maps_eng_labeled"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define Translation Dictionaries (The Fix)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 2.1 Region (County) Dictionary - 全台 22 縣市
county_dict <- c(
  "臺北市" = "Taipei City",      "新北市" = "New Taipei City",
  "基隆市" = "Keelung City",     "桃園市" = "Taoyuan City",
  "新竹市" = "Hsinchu City",     "新竹縣" = "Hsinchu County",
  "苗栗縣" = "Miaoli County",    "臺中市" = "Taichung City",
  "彰化縣" = "Changhua County",  "南投縣" = "Nantou County",
  "雲林縣" = "Yunlin County",    "嘉義市" = "Chiayi City",
  "嘉義縣" = "Chiayi County",    "臺南市" = "Tainan City",
  "高雄市" = "Kaohsiung City",   "屏東縣" = "Pingtung County",
  "宜蘭縣" = "Yilan County",     "花蓮縣" = "Hualien County",
  "臺東縣" = "Taitung County",   "澎湖縣" = "Penghu County",
  "金門縣" = "Kinmen County",    "連江縣" = "Lienchiang County"
)

# 2.2 District Dictionary (重點區域+常見區域)
# 如果有缺漏的鄉鎮，圖表會顯示拼音或原名，不會報錯
district_dict <- c(
  # --- Hsinchu Area ---
  "竹北市" = "Zhubei City",      "竹東鎮" = "Zhudong Township",
  "新埔鎮" = "Xinpu Township",   "關西鎮" = "Guanxi Township",
  "湖口鄉" = "Hukou Township",   "新豐鄉" = "Xinfeng Township",
  "芎林鄉" = "Qionglin Township","橫山鄉" = "Hengshan Township",
  "北埔鄉" = "Beipu Township",   "寶山鄉" = "Baoshan Township",
  "峨眉鄉" = "Emei Township",    "尖石鄉" = "Jianshi Township",
  "五峰鄉" = "Wufeng Township",  "東區"   = "East Dist.", 
  "北區"   = "North Dist.",      "香山區" = "Xiangshan Dist.",
  
  # --- Taipei City ---
  "中正區" = "Zhongzheng Dist.", "大同區" = "Datong Dist.",
  "中山區" = "Zhongshan Dist.",  "松山區" = "Songshan Dist.",
  "大安區" = "Da'an Dist.",      "萬華區" = "Wanhua Dist.",
  "信義區" = "Xinyi Dist.",      "士林區" = "Shilin Dist.",
  "北投區" = "Beitou Dist.",     "內湖區" = "Neihu Dist.",
  "南港區" = "Nangang Dist.",    "文山區" = "Wenshan Dist.",
  
  # --- New Taipei City ---
  "板橋區" = "Banqiao Dist.",    "三重區" = "Sanchong Dist.",
  "中和區" = "Zhonghe Dist.",    "永和區" = "Yonghe Dist.",
  "新莊區" = "Xinzhuang Dist.",  "新店區" = "Xindian Dist.",
  "土城區" = "Tucheng Dist.",    "蘆洲區" = "Luzhou Dist.",
  "汐止區" = "Xizhi Dist.",      "樹林區" = "Shulin Dist.",
  "淡水區" = "Tamsui Dist.",     "鶯歌區" = "Yingge Dist.",
  "三峽區" = "Sanxia Dist.",     "五股區" = "Wugu Dist.",
  "泰山區" = "Taishan Dist.",    "林口區" = "Linkou Dist.",
  "深坑區" = "Shenkeng Dist.",   "石碇區" = "Shiding Dist.",
  "坪林區" = "Pinglin Dist.",    "三芝區" = "Sanzhi Dist.",
  "石門區" = "Shimen Dist.",     "八里區" = "Bali Dist.",
  "平溪區" = "Pingxi Dist.",     "雙溪區" = "Shuangxi Dist.",
  "貢寮區" = "Gongliao Dist.",   "金山區" = "Jinshan Dist.",
  "萬里區" = "Wanli Dist.",      "烏來區" = "Wulai Dist.",
  "瑞芳區" = "Ruifang Dist."
)

translate_region <- function(x) {
  res <- county_dict[x]
  ifelse(is.na(res), x, res)
}

translate_district <- function(x) {
  res <- district_dict[x]
  ifelse(is.na(res), x, res) # 如果字典裡沒有，就維持中文，避免空白
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Load Data & Shapefile
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[1/4] Loading Data...\n")

# 3.1 Load Aging Data
df_aging_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "population_index", "aging_index_202412.csv"), skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(df_aging_raw) <- c("CID", "COUNTY", "TID", "TOWN", "M_F", "PH", "PDEN", 
                            "DEP_RAT", "YOUNG_RAT", "OLD_RAT", "AGING_IDX", "TIME")

aging_data <- df_aging_raw %>%
  rename(Region_Chi = COUNTY, District_Chi = TOWN) %>%
  mutate(
    Dependency_Ratio = as.numeric(DEP_RAT),
    Region_Chi = str_trim(Region_Chi),
    District_Chi = str_trim(District_Chi)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Region_Chi = str_replace_all(Region_Chi, "台", "臺")) %>%
  select(Region_Chi, District_Chi, Dependency_Ratio)

# 3.2 Load Shapefile (The one causing issues)
shp_path <- here("data", "map", "TOWN_MOI_1140318.shp")
if (!file.exists(shp_path)) stop("Error: Shapefile not found!")

tw_town_sf <- st_read(shp_path, quiet = TRUE) 

# --- CRITICAL FIX: Manually create English columns using dictionaries ---
# We assume the shapefile has 'COUNTYNAME' and 'TOWNNAME' (Standard Chinese columns)
tw_town_sf <- tw_town_sf %>%
  rename(Region_Chi = COUNTYNAME, District_Chi = TOWNNAME) %>%
  mutate(Region_Chi = str_replace_all(Region_Chi, "台", "臺")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Region_Eng = translate_region(Region_Chi),
    District_Eng = translate_district(District_Chi)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3.3 Merge Data
map_data_all <- tw_town_sf %>%
  left_join(aging_data, by = c("Region_Chi", "District_Chi")) %>%
  mutate(
    Label_Text = paste0(District_Eng, "\n", round(Dependency_Ratio, 1), "%")
  )

cat("Data Merged. Total Districts:", nrow(map_data_all), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Generate National Map (English)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[2/4] Generating National Map...\n")

p_national <- ggplot(map_data_all) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Dependency_Ratio), color = NA, size = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma", 
    direction = -1, 
    name = "Dependency\nRatio (%)",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Dependency Ratio by District in Taiwan",
    subtitle = "Higher Ratio indicates heavier burden on working population",
    caption = "Source: Ministry of the Interior | Visualized by R"
  ) +
  my_theme_map +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(118.0, 122.4), 
    ylim = c(21.8, 26.4)
  )

ggsave(here("output", "maps_eng_labeled", "Map_National_Eng.png"), 
       p_national, width = 12, height = 16, bg = "white")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Generate County Maps (English Labels + Values)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[3/4] Generating County Maps with English Labels & Values...\n")

# Loop through regions that we have data for
county_list <- unique(map_data_all$Region_Chi)
county_list <- county_list[!is.na(county_list)]

for (county_chi in county_list) {
  
  # Retrieve English name from our translated data
  county_eng <- map_data_all$Region_Eng[map_data_all$Region_Chi == county_chi][1]
  
  # Safe filename
  filename_part <- str_replace_all(county_eng, " ", "")
  
  cat("  Processing:", county_eng, "...\n")
  
  # Filter
  county_map_data <- map_data_all %>% filter(Region_Chi == county_chi)
  
  # Centroids
  county_centroids <- suppressWarnings(st_centroid(county_map_data))
  coords <- st_coordinates(county_centroids)
  county_map_data <- cbind(county_map_data, coords)
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(county_map_data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = Dependency_Ratio), color = "white", size = 0.2) +
    
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(x = X, y = Y, label = Label_Text),
      size = 3,
      family = "Arial",
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black",
      bg.color = "white",
      bg.r = 0.15,
      lineheight = 0.8,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      force = ifelse(county_eng %in% c("Kaohsiung City", "Taipei City", "New Taipei City"), 2, 5),
      max.overlaps = 30
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "magma", 
      direction = -1, 
      name = "Dep. Ratio (%)",
      na.value = "grey90"
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste(county_eng, "- Dependency Ratio"),
      subtitle = "District Name / Percentage (%)",
      caption = "PBAG2 Analysis"
    ) +
    my_theme_map
  
  # Zoom Logic
  if (county_chi == "高雄市") {
    p <- p + coord_sf(xlim = c(120.15, 121.10), ylim = c(22.40, 23.50))
  } else if (county_chi == "宜蘭縣") {
    p <- p + coord_sf(xlim = c(121.30, 122.05), ylim = c(24.28, 25.02))
  }
  
  ggsave(here("output", "maps_eng_labeled", paste0("Map_", filename_part, "_Eng.png")), 
         p, width = 10, height = 10, bg = "white")
}

cat("\n[4/4] All Done! Check 'output/maps_eng_labeled' folder.\n")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Project: Dependency Ratio Mapping (Robust English Version)
# Author: PBAG2
# Date: 2025-12-03
# Description: 
#   1. Handles Shapefiles missing English columns.
#   2. Uses manual dictionary for translation.
#   3. Generates English Maps with Values.
# ==============================================================================

rm(list = ls()) # Clear environment

# 1. Setup & Libraries
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
packages <- c("readr", "dplyr", "stringr", "ggplot2", "sf", "viridis", "here", "ggrepel")
for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# Theme
my_theme_map <- theme_void(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey60", hjust = 1)
  )

dir.create(here("output", "maps_eng_labeled"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define Translation Dictionaries (The Fix)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 2.1 Region (County) Dictionary - 全台 22 縣市
county_dict <- c(
  "臺北市" = "Taipei City",      "新北市" = "New Taipei City",
  "基隆市" = "Keelung City",     "桃園市" = "Taoyuan City",
  "新竹市" = "Hsinchu City",     "新竹縣" = "Hsinchu County",
  "苗栗縣" = "Miaoli County",    "臺中市" = "Taichung City",
  "彰化縣" = "Changhua County",  "南投縣" = "Nantou County",
  "雲林縣" = "Yunlin County",    "嘉義市" = "Chiayi City",
  "嘉義縣" = "Chiayi County",    "臺南市" = "Tainan City",
  "高雄市" = "Kaohsiung City",   "屏東縣" = "Pingtung County",
  "宜蘭縣" = "Yilan County",     "花蓮縣" = "Hualien County",
  "臺東縣" = "Taitung County",   "澎湖縣" = "Penghu County",
  "金門縣" = "Kinmen County",    "連江縣" = "Lienchiang County"
)

# 2.2 District Dictionary (重點區域+常見區域)
# 如果有缺漏的鄉鎮，圖表會顯示拼音或原名，不會報錯
district_dict <- c(
  # --- Hsinchu Area ---
  "竹北市" = "Zhubei City",      "竹東鎮" = "Zhudong Township",
  "新埔鎮" = "Xinpu Township",   "關西鎮" = "Guanxi Township",

  "芎林鄉" = "Qionglin Township","橫山鄉" = "Hengshan Township",
  "北埔鄉" = "Beipu Township",   "寶山鄉" = "Baoshan Township",
  "峨眉鄉" = "Emei Township",    "尖石鄉" = "Jianshi Township",
  "五峰鄉" = "Wufeng Township",  "東區"   = "East Dist.", 
  "北區"   = "North Dist.",      "香山區" = "Xiangshan Dist.",
  
  # --- Taipei City ---
  "中正區" = "Zhongzheng Dist.", "大同區" = "Datong Dist.",
  "中山區" = "Zhongshan Dist.",  "松山區" = "Songshan Dist.",
  "大安區" = "Da'an Dist.",      "萬華區" = "Wanhua Dist.",
  "信義區" = "Xinyi Dist.",      "士林區" = "Shilin Dist.",
  "北投區" = "Beitou Dist.",     "內湖區" = "Neihu Dist.",
  "南港區" = "Nangang Dist.",    "文山區" = "Wenshan Dist.",
  
  # --- New Taipei City ---
  "板橋區" = "Banqiao Dist.",    "三重區" = "Sanchong Dist.",
  "中和區" = "Zhonghe Dist.",    "永和區" = "Yonghe Dist.",
  "新莊區" = "Xinzhuang Dist.",  "新店區" = "Xindian Dist.",
  "土城區" = "Tucheng Dist.",    "蘆洲區" = "Luzhou Dist.",
  "汐止區" = "Xizhi Dist.",      "樹林區" = "Shulin Dist.",
  "淡水區" = "Tamsui Dist.",     "鶯歌區" = "Yingge Dist.",
  "三峽區" = "Sanxia Dist.",     "五股區" = "Wugu Dist.",
  "泰山區" = "Taishan Dist.",    "林口區" = "Linkou Dist.",
  "深坑區" = "Shenkeng Dist.",   "石碇區" = "Shiding Dist.",
  "坪林區" = "Pinglin Dist.",    "三芝區" = "Sanzhi Dist.",
  "石門區" = "Shimen Dist.",     "八里區" = "Bali Dist.",
  "平溪區" = "Pingxi Dist.",     "雙溪區" = "Shuangxi Dist.",
  "貢寮區" = "Gongliao Dist.",   "金山區" = "Jinshan Dist.",
  "萬里區" = "Wanli Dist.",      "烏來區" = "Wulai Dist.",
  "瑞芳區" = "Ruifang Dist."
)

translate_region <- function(x) {
  res <- county_dict[x]
  ifelse(is.na(res), x, res)
}

translate_district <- function(x) {
  res <- district_dict[x]
  ifelse(is.na(res), x, res) # 如果字典裡沒有，就維持中文，避免空白
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Load Data & Shapefile
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[1/4] Loading Data...\n")

# 3.1 Load Aging Data
df_aging_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "population_index", "aging_index_202412.csv"), skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(df_aging_raw) <- c("CID", "COUNTY", "TID", "TOWN", "M_F", "PH", "PDEN", 
                            "DEP_RAT", "YOUNG_RAT", "OLD_RAT", "AGING_IDX", "TIME")

aging_data <- df_aging_raw %>%
  rename(Region_Chi = COUNTY, District_Chi = TOWN) %>%
  mutate(
    Dependency_Ratio = as.numeric(DEP_RAT),
    Region_Chi = str_trim(Region_Chi),
    District_Chi = str_trim(District_Chi)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Region_Chi = str_replace_all(Region_Chi, "台", "臺")) %>%
  select(Region_Chi, District_Chi, Dependency_Ratio)

# 3.2 Load Shapefile (The one causing issues)
shp_path <- here("data", "map", "TOWN_MOI_1140318.shp")
if (!file.exists(shp_path)) stop("Error: Shapefile not found!")

tw_town_sf <- st_read(shp_path, quiet = TRUE) 

# --- CRITICAL FIX: Manually create English columns using dictionaries ---
# We assume the shapefile has 'COUNTYNAME' and 'TOWNNAME' (Standard Chinese columns)
tw_town_sf <- tw_town_sf %>%
  rename(Region_Chi = COUNTYNAME, District_Chi = TOWNNAME) %>%
  mutate(Region_Chi = str_replace_all(Region_Chi, "台", "臺")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Region_Eng = translate_region(Region_Chi),
    District_Eng = translate_district(District_Chi)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3.3 Merge Data
map_data_all <- tw_town_sf %>%
  left_join(aging_data, by = c("Region_Chi", "District_Chi")) %>%
  mutate(
    Label_Text = paste0(District_Eng, "\n", round(Dependency_Ratio, 1), "%")
  )

cat("Data Merged. Total Districts:", nrow(map_data_all), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Generate National Map (English)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[2/4] Generating National Map...\n")

p_national <- ggplot(map_data_all) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Dependency_Ratio), color = NA, size = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma", 
    direction = -1, 
    name = "Dependency\nRatio (%)",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Dependency Ratio by District in Taiwan",
    subtitle = "Higher Ratio indicates heavier burden on working population",
    caption = "Source: Ministry of the Interior | Visualized by R"
  ) +
  my_theme_map +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(118.0, 122.4), 
    ylim = c(21.8, 26.4)
  )

ggsave(here("output", "maps_eng_labeled", "Map_National_Eng.png"),
```
